_about: Hand-kept causes and statuses for the wiring-campaign gap tracker. Rules are matched in order; the first match wins. 'match' is a scenario-id prefix or an exact id. Statuses: rerun-pending (fix deployed, not re-run yet), open (cause known, no fix yet), investigate (cause not yet known), review (verdict needs a human look), declared-gap (accepted limitation), removed.
